description:
A perennial runner-up at a witch academy finally snaps after another loss to her icy aristocratic rival. In a drunken moment, she casts a forbidden spell meant to humiliate him only for it to go terribly wrong. The curse twists into a lingering hypnosis, turning their rivalry into a dangerous secret of nights charged with desire and days filled with hostility. As attraction grows against her will, she must break the spell before rivalry becomes love.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/297086111), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13631903), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000075419), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=260012)
